quiz.description: Test how well you know the applications of artificial intelligence in the logistics industry
quiz.category_subtitle: Questions will be randomly selected from the chosen topic
quiz.intro_text: The quiz covers: demand forecasting, route optimization, fleet management, warehouse operations and AI implementation. Perfect preparation for a strategic conversation about digital transformation.

results.expert_subtitle: Excellent score! You understand the strategic value of AI for the logistics industry. You're ready to lead digital transformation in your area.
results.good_subtitle: Good score — you know the key AI applications. It's worth deepening your knowledge of the topics where you made mistakes, as that's where the optimization opportunities lie.
results.average_subtitle: You have the basics — now it's time to deepen your knowledge. Focus especially on ROI from AI and deployment models. We recommend reviewing the presentation materials.
results.beginner_subtitle: AI in logistics is a topic worth mastering — it will be crucial in the coming years. Return to the training materials and try the quiz again!
